description: Image Description: The image captures a serene coastal scene during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset. A single surfboard lies horizontally on wet, reflective sand near the water's edge. The board is white with visible fins at the tail end and rests in shallow water, casting a faint shadow. The surface of the sand is rippled and textured, reflecting the sky above, which is filled with soft clouds illuminated by the golden light of the sun breaking through.
